name: Read an analog pin (ADC)
description: Read a potentiometer, light sensor, or other analog input.
setup_guide: This template returns `raw_value` (0-65535) and `voltage` (0-3.3V) on every run. To see it on the dashboard: open the module, go to the Variables section, add a new variable named `voltage` (Type: number), then attach a Gauge or Line Chart visualization with JSON Path `voltage`, min 0, max 3.3, unit 'V', 2 decimals.
